instructionSummary: Edit the existing flat five-strip texture atlas, with warm engraved storybook frontier materials matching the Baron illustration. Vertical walnut grain, aged engraved brass, blue-black worn iron, restrained teal glass and ember orange. Flat surface patterns only; no objects, captions or perspective. Replace repeated coarse diagonal pattern with material-specific details.
packingNote: Native output was 1254 square and repositioned the strip boundaries. Builder UV regions were fitted inside the actual new strips, then output downsampled to 512. Geometry remains unchanged. Technical roughness/metalness and selective-emission maps are deterministic data derived from the same UV regions, not separately generated artwork. Final data maps pad UV boundaries by four pixels; emission includes a 12% illustrated shadow fill outside full-strength functional teal/ember regions. Existing front launcher-band UVs use teal so the warning remains visible after correcting the mount orientation.
